info.name: Velzon Admin API
info.description: Postman collection for the NestJS backend in Admin_Dashboard_next_velzon_eng. API prefix /api/v1. Import the companion environment or set variables manually. Login stores accessToken automatically. CMS payload examples are starting points; verify DTOs in Swagger.

item.name: Register USER
item.description: Always creates role USER. Password must be 12-72 chars.

item.name: Login
item.description: Stores response.accessToken in the accessToken collection variable.

item.name: 02 - Business API
item.description: JWT required. Most write operations require ADMIN or MANAGER. Pagination: page, limit (max 100), search.

item.name: 04 - CMS Admin (JWT + permissions)
item.description: Routes require JWT and the matching CMS permission grant. ADMIN bypasses CMS grants. Request bodies are illustrative; Swagger is the source of truth for DTO validation.

item.name: Upload media (multipart)
item.description: Use form-data key `file` with a file. Check the controller DTO for supported metadata fields.

item.name: 05 - Public CMS (no token)
item.description: Published content and public form endpoints do not require a Bearer token.

item.name: Publish scheduled content
item.description: Server-side scheduler only. Set Authorization: Bearer {{cmsJobToken}} manually; never expose cmsJobToken in frontend code.

item.name: Dispatch webhook queue
item.description: Server-side scheduler only. Set Authorization: Bearer {{cmsJobToken}} manually; never expose cmsJobToken in frontend code.
